about: roots reggae: a one-drop on a dry room kit (kick and rim together on 3, swung hats), a deep round bass loud and melodic with space between the notes, a clean guitar skanking short chords on the off-beats, a reedy harmonica line as the melodica; 65-85 BPM, laid back, warm, with echo
master: warm and bass-heavy, top end soft; spring reverb and tape echo on the rim and skank, never bright or squashed
